newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo stocks close higher led by blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Colombo stocks close higher led by blue chips.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed slightly higher in trading dominated by a handful of blue chips on Monday, brokers siad.
Helped by gains of National Development Bank and Richrd Pieris, the all share index closed 1.3 points higher at 574.14.
The two blue chips accounted for well over the half of total trade volume of 796,714 shares, brokers said.
"There would have been more activity if only we could match buying and selling," said Shanil Perera of Lanka Securities.
Price gains led declines by 20 to eight.
National Development Bank rose three rupees to 200 on foreign buying and Richrd Pieris & Co 7.25 to 102 due to a boardroom battle among the group's major shareholders, brokers said.
Buyers were willing to enter at current merket levels or five percent below, but sellers were holding out for premiums as high as 10 to 20 percent, Perera said.
"Sellers tend to move further back with every point the index gains," he said.
Turnover was an active 52.3 million rupees
